recent.label: Man in black
recent.text:
Sensing trouble, a mysterious man in black has arrived.

Will he be able to set things right in these parts?

recent.label: Psychic soothe: Male
recent.text:
Every male colonist smiles with contentment!

Some distant engine of happiness is stirring. It is projecting a psychic drone onto this site through an orbital amplifier, tuned to only affect males. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit better.
<color=#D09B61FF>Trocam</color> and <color=#D09B61FF>Red</color> joked about cooking with gourds.
<color=#D09B61FF>Red</color> offered a backhanded compliment about <color=#D09B61FF>Snail</color>'s food preferences.
